xiamen-university.about:
Xiamen University was founded in 1921 by overseas Chinese philanthropist Tan Kah Kee and sits on the sea in Xiamen, Fujian. It is especially strong in economics, finance and accounting, chemistry, marine and oceanographic science, and Chinese language teaching, and operates Xiamen University Malaysia near Kuala Lumpur.

International undergraduates on the China campus apply with school records, HSK (or English scores for English-taught options) and a CSCA report. CSC and Fujian scholarships are available.
xiamen-university.aid_intl: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.
xiamen-university.tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.
xiamen-university.gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.
requirements: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

xian-jiaotong-university.about:
Xi'an Jiaotong University traces its roots to Nanyang Public School founded in Shanghai in 1896 and moved to Xi'an in the 1950s. It is a top engineering university in energy and power, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and materials, with a large medical school and a strong management school.

International undergraduates apply online with school records, HSK (or English scores for English-taught MBBS and other programmes) and a CSCA report. CSC and Silk Road scholarships are available.
